[ onomat. ], the name of a bird; ; — ° âbhinadita , n. , the sound of cihaciha birds; ; Th 49 (~e sippikābhirutehi ca na me taṃ phandati cittaṃ, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se viha-vihābhinadite, prob. wr ; Th-a I 129, 29 foll. : cihacihā ti abhiṇhaṃ pavattasaddatāya cihacihā ti laddhanāmānaṃ vaṭṭakānaṃ abhinādananimittaṃ viravahetū ti attho, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce vihavihā ti).
NCP: masculine | cihacihaabhinadita (onomat). the sound of cihaciha birds; or the sound of chirping.
